Enter the token through a secure local secret/environment mechanism outside the repository, using CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN for the process that performs the read checks. Use a local masked entry or secret manager, never a literal command saved to history.
Never paste the token into ChatGPT, print it, include it in JSON, or commit it. Confirm only that local credential provisioning is ready.

In a subsequent authorized read verification, check the intended site-list endpoint first, derive the actual ruleset identifier, and verify rules-list read. If still denied, stop and diagnose without adding Account Settings Write.
